ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: If the squirrels were removed from the food web, which organism would most likely have a decrease in population?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The title in the diagram is “Food Web”. There is a wolf in the upper right, with an arrow pointing from wolf to the squirrel in the middle right; another arrow points from squirrel to the acorn in the lower right. The arrows in the diagram indicate consumers pointing to the food or organism they depend on. Reasoning: If squirrels are removed, the wolf that depends on squirrels as food will lose part of its food source, so the wolf population is most likely to decrease.
